confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident for a tourist-area Antalya, since lira-denominated prices move quickly. Accommodation is less certain, especially for July peak-season pricing, so treat the hostel and hotel anchors as wide bands. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor, as the tourist-bar price relationship was weaker in direct knowledge. Turkey is transcontinental; it is placed in Middle East for this classification. The FX figure was reported in a search-result summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, but I did not open that page directly, so it is unverified and the 16 October 2026 figure could not be confirmed on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Turkish Mediterranean resort towns (for example Bodrum and Fethiye) with lira-based pricing and a July tourist peak. Accommodation anchors reflect typical July rates in Antalya's coastal and old-town areas, including taxes and mandatory fees. Cocktail and wine anchors follow the beer anchor using the typical tourist-bar price ratio.
